WITH candidatos AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         p.nombre,
         c.nombre AS cliente,
         GREATEST(
           similarity(unaccent(lower(p.nombre)), unaccent(lower($1::text))),
           COALESCE(MAX(similarity(unaccent(lower(pa.alias)), unaccent(lower($1::text)))), 0)
         ) AS score
  FROM proyectos p
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = p.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN proyecto_alias pa ON pa.proyecto_id = p.id
  WHERE p.activo
  GROUP BY p.id, p.nombre, c.nombre
)
SELECT id, nombre, cliente, score
FROM candidatos
WHERE score >= 0.35
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 3;

UPDATE registros_entrada
SET json_extraido = $1::jsonb,
    estado = $2,
    campo_pendiente = $3,
    modelo_ia = 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite',
    error_detalle = $5,
    actualizado_en = now()
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING id;

WITH pendiente AS (
  SELECT id, usuario_id, estado, campo_pendiente, json_extraido
  FROM registros_entrada
  WHERE usuario_id = $1 AND estado = 'falta_dato'
  ORDER BY id DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT p.*
FROM (SELECT 1) AS dummy
LEFT JOIN pendiente p ON TRUE;
